name: Yamaha XT250
engine: 249 cc air-cooled SOHC single; carb or fuel injection depending on year
intro: A light dual-sport. 2013-2015 bikes had an air induction hose recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2013-2015 XT250s are in recall 14V754. Dealers replace the air induction pipe and hose.

G: Check whether your bike has a carb or fuel injection and skip the steps that don't match.

recalls.what: Air induction pipe and hose defect.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the pipe and hose free.
